question: Should `optimizeImages` forwarding and `maxDurationSeconds` remain permanent general-purpose Plugin SDK contracts, or should WhatsApp retain owner-local adaptation until another plugin needs them?
rationale: The code is a focused refactor, but the two new shared helper options define reusable plugin-facing behavior whose long-term contract cannot be selected mechanically from WhatsApp’s immediate needs alone.

options.title: Accept the shared contracts
options.body: Keep the new options in the existing shared helpers, record their API baseline intentionally, and land after final-head validation.

options.title: Keep adaptation local
options.body: Move the WhatsApp-specific duration and optimization adaptation back behind owner-local code, leaving the shared SDK surface unchanged until broader reuse is demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared contracts
recommendation.body: Keep the new options in the existing shared helpers, record their API baseline intentionally, and land after final-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed WhatsApp work makes this contributor the clearest available routing candidate for the channel-side contract rationale.
